name: check_messages
summary: List the most recent messages from Messages.app (iMessage/SMS), optionally only unread ones from others. Reads the local Messages DB (needs Full Disk Access).

params.name: unread_only
params.description: Only unread messages received from others (default false).

name: search_messages
summary: Search message text for a term, most recent first. Reads the local Messages DB (needs Full Disk Access).

params.name: query
params.description: Text to find in message bodies (case-insensitive substring).

name: read_conversation
summary: Show the recent message history with one person, by phone/email handle OR contact_name (resolved via Contacts). Reads the local Messages DB (needs Full Disk Access).

params.name: handle
params.description: Other party's phone or email (as shown by check_messages/list_conversations). Provide this OR contact_name, not both.

params.name: contact_name
params.description: Name to look up in Contacts. Provide this OR handle, not both. An ambiguous name is refused with the candidates.

name: list_conversations
summary: List recent conversations, each with its last message and timestamp. Reads the local Messages DB (needs Full Disk Access).

name: send_message
summary: Send an iMessage, optionally with one or more file attachments (images, PDFs, etc.). STAGED; irreversible — there is no way to unsend. Recipient as a phone/email handle OR contact_name. Provide text, attachments, or both.

params.name: text
params.description: Message text. Optional when attachments are supplied; at least one of text/attachments is required.

params.name: attachments
params.description: Path(s) of existing regular file(s) to attach (leading ~ ok). If you only know roughly where a file is (e.g. "in Downloads"), locate it with the filesystem tool first, then pass the resolved path here.

params.name: handle
params.description: Recipient phone or email (iMessage handle). Provide this OR contact_name, not both.

params.name: contact_name
params.description: Name to look up in Contacts. Provide this OR handle, not both. An ambiguous name is refused with the candidates.
